title: Stackbear Enameled Cast Iron Dutch Oven, Cream Pink White

comparisons.notes: Brand's own store, ChromaVibe X, Serene variant, in stock at $99.99. Photo match to the Woot image: same cream-to-pink ombre rounded-square body, pink X-shaped silicone trivet lid and multi-ball knob.

writeup: Stackbear's enameled cast iron Dutch oven in the cream-to-pink ombre finish is $34.99 new at Woot. The X on the lid is a removable silicone trivet, and the pot is oven safe to 482°F. Stackbear's own store sells the same pot (ChromaVibe X, Serene) for $99.99, so Woot is about $65 less. Woot showed only 1 left, limit 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Exact ASIN verified by price checker on the Woot offer page (Chroma Vibe Cream Pink White).
